prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1117; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain, reduced range of motion, and intermittent pain radiating into the upper arm. Initial examination revealed tenderness over the anterior shoulder, limited active abduction and forward flexion, and pain with resisted external rotation. Imaging was obtained to rule out fracture, and no acute bony abnormality was identified. Clinical findings were most consistent with a soft tissue injury involving the rotator cuff and periscapular musculature.

Over the course of seven visits, treatment consisted of a structured physical therapy program including manual therapy, progressive range of motion exercises, and graded strengthening. Anti-inflammatory medication was prescribed for pain control, and activity modification was advised during the early phase of recovery. The patient demonstrated steady improvement in pain scores and shoulder mobility across visits, with range of motion approaching functional norms by the final encounter.

At discharge, the patient reported marked reduction in pain with occasional discomfort after prolonged overhead activity. Residual mild weakness remains, and a home exercise program was provided. Continued self-directed rehabilitation is recommended, with follow-up as needed should symptoms recur or fail to resolve.
